name: Kawasaki KH250 / KH400
engine: 249 or 400 cc air-cooled two-stroke triple, oil injection
intro: The later versions of the S1 and S3 triples. Smoother and a bit tamer than the early bikes.

G: Check the oil injection: the tank feeds the pump, the lines are bled, and the pump cable opens with the throttle.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
